title.narrative: Participatory, Inclusive and Green Recovery for Local Public Services in the Earthquake-Affected Region

description.narrative: The overall objective of this stand-alone Action is to contribute to Türkiye¿s earthquake recovery by supporting participatory, inclusive and green public service delivery at local level based on ESG principles. The assistance is designed to support the affected Local Authorities in pursuing efficient service delivery practices across public administration at provincial and local level that directly impact the recovery efforts on the ground by restoring the delivery of local public services to the population and strengthening transparency and accountability overall, thus ultimately speeding up a greener socio-economic recovery and climate resilient development. Moreover, the Action also help local authorities in the earthquake-affected region to rebuild their cities in a greener, high-quality, climate resilient and inclusive way in line with the EU¿s twin green and digital transition policies. The envisaged specific objectives imply improved quality of public service delivery of earthquake-stricken local authorities (LAs) and enabled civic engagement in the recovery efforts with inclusive, green and climate resilient approach. This will be achieved by improving local level recovery planning and management capacity of local authorities to provide local public services. These interventions will be combined with supporting civic engagement in planning, development and monitoring as well as implementing grant scheme programmes for CSOs and non-governmental organisations in their area of competence to help earthquake recovery efforts.
